paragraphs: In [Chullin 67b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.67b.12): Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Acha bar Nafcha, according to the reading of the Rif, [the Rosh](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Chullin.3.69.1) and Dikdukei Soferim; in the Gemara texts Hyman uses the words “bar Nafcha” are missing.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rav Mesharshiya son of Rav Acha. The linked Rosh adds “bar Nafcha” after Rav Acha. The readings from the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim remain as Hyman reports them.
